name: Snowdrop bush
desc: Snowdrop bush (Styrax redivivus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 76 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Styrax redivivus, with common names that include snowdrop bush, California styrax, bitternut, drug snowbell, and chaparral snowbell, is a species of flowering plant in the family Styracaceae.
